text: No, the evidence does not show forest loss across the surrounding region within the asset boundary during the evaluated period (2021–2025). The analysis detected no tree-cover loss events exceeding 0.5 hectares. However, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or those at asset edges may have been missed due to pixel resolution limits. Historical losses occurred before 2021, with notable events in 2015 (25.5 ha) and 2020 (67.7 ha). The asset had minimal forest cover by 2020 (0 ha per JRC data). While no recent loss was detected, the evidence does not rule out minor or undetectable changes.
